exposure: ultrasonographic visualization of fetal intestinal peristalsis in utero
cohort: Pregnant bitches presented to a veterinary hospital were studied to assess fetal bowel development.
finding: Ultrasonographic evaluation of bowel development can monitor pregnancy progression and reliably identify the end of fetal organogenesis; however, peristalsis detection alone should not be the sole indicator for cesarean section planning as it does not confirm bowel functionality.
mod_finding: While fetal bowel development and peristalsis detection can be correlated with delivery type, ultrasonographic detection of peristalsis alone should not be the sole indicator for cesarean section planning.
gest_age: Gestational age was a variable correlated with fetal bowel development.
